name: EPIC 246057503
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 17.8 solar radii and 1.38 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246057503 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 17.774513 (16th-84th percentiles 16.770309-18.83239), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246057503 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.381788 (16th-84th percentiles 1.213573-1.570245), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246057503: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4522.2446 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246057503 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3888.398438 (16th-84th percentiles 3721.25-4060.898438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,888 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.38 solar masses and 17.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,522 K at its surface.
